changelog: Weighted random can now shuffle episodes within each chosen series while retaining the source probabilities and block size. Film night shows the actual selected film length, never cuts an episode for a scheduled film, and can move the film start up to 30 minutes to finish the current programme cleanly without a lead-in gap.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
